title: Service registry, discovery and API gateway

videos.script: In lesson 2 the catalogue found the stock service by its name in a compose file. That works while there is one stock service, at one address, that never moves. {{one}} In production there are several instances. They start and stop all day, with deploys, with load, with failures, and each one gets a new address. {{many}} Something has to know, at every moment, which instances exist and which of them are healthy. That is a service registry. {{registry}} On your machine the registry is Consul, and three stock instances register themselves in it, each with a health check. {{consul}} In front of them sits an API gateway, Traefik, which reads the registry and sends each request to a healthy instance. {{gateway}} You will make one instance sick and watch the gateway stop using it, stop another and watch it disappear, and send the gateway more requests than it allows. {{sick}} And you will look inside Consul, which turns out to be lesson 10's consensus store, keeping its own copies in agreement.
